name: kernel
description: Persistent Python or JS eval kernel for the current session. Off by default (kernel.enabled = false): this is an unsandboxed subprocess with the host's ambient filesystem permission. Input {kernel:"python"|"js", cell, reset?, timeout_ms?}. Magic prefixes: %pip install, %time, %%bash, !cmd.
llm_description: Session-scoped Python/JS eval kernel. Disabled unless kernel.enabled=true (unsandboxed subprocess). {kernel:'python'|'js', cell, reset?, timeout_ms?}. Magics: %pip, %time, %%bash, !cmd.

cell.description: Code to execute in the persistent kernel.

reset.description: Kill and restart the kernel before this cell.
